units.assertion: Subsection (2) addresses hospitals' expressed confusion about RCW  70.41.560 state requirements and federal requirements under 42 C.F.R. Part 180.

evidence.quote: Subsection (2) of the proposed rule addresses confusion expressed by hospitals regarding state requirements under RCW  70.41.560 and federal price transparency requirements under 42 C.F.R. Part 180 by clarifying that the federal requirements, as they existed as of January 1, 2025, are the required minimum. However, any additional or different types of data elements beyond what was required as of January 1, 2025, by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) may be included in the data submitted to the department. The intent is to clarify that data submitted to the department may meet the current or historical CMS requirements, as long as CMS has not removed reporting requirements. Changes made by CMS to 45 C.F.R. Part 180 since January 1, 2025, have only added data reporting elements.

units.assertion: The proposed rule incorporates RCW  70.41.560 requirements and clarifies how the department interprets whether hospitals meet them.

evidence.quote: Reasons Supporting Proposal: The proposed new rule incorporates the requirements of RCW  70.41.560 while clarifying how the department will interpret if the hospitals have met them or not. Together, RCW  70.41.560 and the proposed new rule set a standard that will improve compliance, allow hospitals to report in a way that meets requirements of this state legislature as well as federal standards, and increase the amount of information available to the public regarding the costs for services and items. It also provides some flexibility to hospitals in an effort to reduce the burden of repetitive and slightly different reporting requirements. Rule making is necessary to provide enforceable minimum standards for the reporting of hospital price transparency and cost data while aligning with RCW  70.41.560.
